notes.title: v0.5.0 Demo Update Major Content & Balance Update
notes.content: [h2]🆕 New Content[/h2][h3]New Weapon[/h3][list][*][p][b]Around Weapon[/b] - A versatile new weapon type added to your arsenal[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535305/ae84e47f18a1632c111398b0c9d94480877070de.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]New Cards[/h3][list][*][p][b]+Crystal Amount[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]New Mechanics[/h3][list][*][p][b]Banish System[/b] - Remove unwanted cards from your upgrade pool[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reroll System[/b] - Refresh your upgrade card options[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skip System[/b] - Pass on upgrade cards without penalty[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535305/a7dce123a0e4cdbc9f58e7ee79a1fe312e522636.png"][/img][/p][h2]🔧 Quality of Life Improvements[/h2][h3]UI/UX Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Upgrade Tooltips[/b] - Hovering over upgrades now displays detailed descriptions[/p][/*][*][p][b]Regeneration Display[/b] - Current health regeneration per second now shown in GUI[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest Management[/b] - Completed quests are automatically removed from quest list[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535305/b4bdbd68ac654fae63c4aec884663541e5f6a11e.png"][/img][/p][h3]Performance & Flow[/h3][list][*][p][b]Portal Speed[/b] - Portal appearance and disappearance animations are now 2x faster[/p][/*][*][p][b]Early Game Pacing[/b] - Enemies now spawn faster at the beginning of runs[/p][/*][*][p][b]Collision Improvements[/b] - Increased collision detection for boxes and pots for better interaction[/p][/*][/list][h2]✨ New Shrine System[/h2][list][*][p][b]Risk/Reward Shrines[/b] - Trade-off shrines that take x2 of one stat while giving x2 of another[/p][/*][*][p][i]Example: Halve player movement speed while doubling attack speed[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535305/aef84a90829e8c0a1d4566390159871a176b8c95.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535305/258b7cf6dfb9bd9afe309137ae89082cdb9eeacd.png"][/img][/p][h2]💰 Economy Rebalancing[/h2][list][*][p][b]Shop Prices[/b] - All shop items reduced by 50%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skill Tree Costs[/b] - All skill tree upgrades reduced[/p][/*][/list][h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Mini-boss Chest[/b] - Fixed issue where mini-bosses weren't spawning treasure chests[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dodge Cap[/b] - Fixed 100% dodge exploit; maximum dodge chance now capped at 50%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level Cap[/b] - Resolved issue where maximum level could exceed 100[/p][/*][*][p][b]Experience Card[/b] - Corrected overpowered +100% Experience card, now provides +50%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Explosion Radius[/b] - Reduced initial explosion radius by 50% for better balance[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][i]This update focuses on expanding player choice while improving game balance and addressing community feedback. Enjoy the new content and enhanced gameplay experience![/i][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.4.0
